description: Eawag publishes the physical and instrument documentation needed to represent its floodX urban flooding testbed at Wangen, Switzerland. The package contains facility plans, an experimental-layout plan, sensor information, dimensions of hydraulic components such as pipes and storage elements, and photographs of the setup. Zenodo lists technical PDFs and ZIP packages, available publicly and free under CC-BY-4.0. Coverage is the static experiment installation; the landing page does not establish a survey date or engineering drawing scale. The provider explicitly supplies the plans without any guarantee of geometric accuracy. That limitation matters when using the documents to build a hydraulic mesh or infer storage volumes. The resource can support construction of an urban flood simulation corresponding to the published observations. It complements the floodX calibration and monitoring data with model geometry and sensor context. The files and PDF contents were not downloaded.
